morphology.pattern_note: 外国国名，整词记忆，无可分析的马来语词缀。保留数据包的小写检索形式；正文按专有名词规范写作 Brazil。音标为马来语读法参考；无据可列的本族派生词，故词族留空。

senses.zh_definition: 巴西：南美洲国家，首都为巴西利亚，官方语言为葡萄牙语。
senses.en_definition: Brazil, a country in South America whose capital is Brasília and whose official language is Portuguese.
senses.ms_definition: Sebuah negara di Amerika Selatan yang beribu negara di Brasília dan menggunakan bahasa Portugis sebagai bahasa rasminya.
senses.nuances: 属于地理专名，正式写作 Brazil；葡萄牙语本国拼写为 Brasil。体育报道中，Brazil 也可依语境代指巴西国家队。此处马来文释义为编写释义；马来西亚官方文本使用 Brazil。[马来西亚首相署：马来西亚与巴西](https://www.pmo.gov.my/en/news-en/malaysia-berbesar-hati-dan-berbangga-tatkala-menerima-kunjungan-rasmi-presiden-lula-dan-isteri-dari-brazil/)

etymology.historical_story: Brazil's name is conventionally linked to pau-brasil, the valuable tree whose wood yielded red dye. Trade in that material helped the name become attached to the territory. The deeper history of brasil has competing explanations, so the tree connection is more secure than a simple claim that the country was directly named after glowing embers. [Fundação Joaquim Nabuco](https://pesquisaescolar.fundaj.gov.br/pt-br/artigo/pau-brasil/), [Brazilian Academy of Letters](https://www.academia.org.br/noticias/abl-na-midia-g1-vai-brasa-afinal-alguem-fala-assim-novo-uniforme-da-selecao-tem-ver-com)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Brazil 的 bra- 联想“巴”，整词连到“巴西”；再记一幅红色染木的画面，连接国名背后的巴西木贸易史。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 国名本身为中性称呼。正式文本使用大写 Brazil；称巴西人可用 warga Brazil 或 rakyat Brazil。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 体育聊天中可直接用 Brazil 代指国家队。与巴西人交流时，应尊重个人背景，避免默认人人都热爱足球，或把葡萄牙语误称为西班牙语。
